map.📖 查看「微生物（致病菌）风险评估使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Microbiological (Pathogen) Risk Assessment Usage Guide"
map.微生物风险评分按 GB 29921 逐项赋分：沙门氏菌、O157 大肠埃希菌等致: The microbiological risk score assigns points item by item under GB 29921: Salmonella and E. coli O157 each add 5 points when detected, Staphylococcus aureus or Shigella above the limit each add 3, and an aerobic plate count above the limit adds 2. A total of 5 or more fails, 3 to 4 needs retesting, and 0 to 2 passes.
map.市场监管抽检风险分级: Risk grading for market surveillance sampling
map.企业品控批次放行: Batch release in factory quality control
map.依据 GB 29921-2021：沙门氏菌/O157 不得检出（检出各 +5）；: Per GB 29921-2021: Salmonella and O157 must not be detected (+5 each when detected); S. aureus, Listeria and V. parahaemolyticus above 100 CFU(MPN)/g each add 3–4; an aerobic plate count above the category limit (meat and aquatic 5×10⁴, dairy and ready-to-eat 1×10⁴) adds 2. Total rs: 0 is safe, ≤3 low risk, ≤8 medium risk and above 8 high risk.
map.即食食品：沙门0、金葡50、O157 0、李斯特0、弧菌0、菌落总数8000(≤: Ready-to-eat food: Salmonella 0, S. aureus 50, O157 0, Listeria 0, Vibrio 0 and a plate count of 8000 (≤1×10⁴) gives rs = 0, safe and passing. Meat product: Salmonella detected (+5), Listeria 250 (+4), S. aureus 150 (+3) and a plate count of 6×10⁴ (+2) gives rs = 14, high risk, so the batch fails and must not be sold.
map.为何致病菌不得检出？: Why must pathogens not be detected?
map.沙门氏菌、大肠埃希氏菌 O157 为致病菌零容忍，GB 29921 规定 n=0: Salmonella and E. coli O157 are pathogens with zero tolerance; GB 29921 sets n = 0 (not detectable in 25 g), so any detection means failure.
map.菌落总数限值怎么分？: How are the plate count limits set?
map.按食品类别：肉制品/水产制品 ≤5×10⁴ CFU/g，乳制品/即食食品 ≤1×: By food category: meat and aquatic products ≤5×10⁴ CFU/g, dairy and ready-to-eat foods ≤1×10⁴ CFU/g; exceeding the limit indicates poor hygiene.
map.GB 29921-2021规定了预包装食品中5种致病菌的限量要求: GB 29921-2021 sets limits for five pathogens in prepackaged foods
map.沙门氏菌和大肠埃希氏菌O157为不得检出(0/25g): Salmonella and E. coli O157 must not be detected (0/25 g)
map.金葡菌限量≤100CFU/g，副溶血性弧菌≤100MPN/g: The S. aureus limit is ≤100 CFU/g and V. parahaemolyticus ≤100 MPN/g
map.李斯特氏菌对即食食品要求≤100CFU/g，孕妇高危: Listeria must be ≤100 CFU/g in ready-to-eat foods, and pregnant women are a high-risk group
map.菌落总数反映总体卫生状况，但不直接等同于致病风险: The aerobic plate count reflects overall hygiene but is not directly the same as pathogenic risk
map.食品微生物致病菌风险评估工具，输入沙门氏菌、金葡菌等检测结果，按GB 29921: A microbiological pathogen risk assessment tool for food: enter Salmonella, S. aureus and other test results and grade the food safety risk against GB 29921.
